fichas.title: Chimney opening and solid-fuel heating room
fichas.summary: Diagram of a solid-fuel boiler room showing the chimney, air supply and waste-air routes. The printed requirements specify a minimum chimney opening, room size, heating capacity and room height.
uses: Provide combustion air and waste-air route

dimensions.label: Minimum chimney opening
dimensions.context: Minimum opening shown for the chimney.

dimensions.label: Minimum heating-room area/volume
dimensions.context: Requirement printed for a heating room for solid fuel; OCR calls this an area, while the unit shown is cubic metres.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Heating room for solid fuel, min. area 8 m3 necessary for heating capacity ≥50 kW

dimensions.label: Heating capacity threshold
dimensions.context: Heating-room requirement applies to heating capacity at or above this threshold.

dimensions.label: Minimum room height
dimensions.context: Clear height indicated inside the heating room diagram.

fichas.title: Heating systems and heat generation
fichas.summary: Overview of building heating systems, heat generators and distribution media. Water is the usual medium; gas and oil boilers are described, along with renewable-energy approaches including geothermal energy, CHP, wood and seasonal thermal-solar storage.
uses: Distribute heat through water, air or, for industrial purposes, steam
Use renewable or conventional energy sources

dimensions.label: Typical boiler combustion temperature
dimensions.context: Approximate combustion temperature in boilers burning heating gas or oil.

dimensions.label: Temperature typically sufficient for heat distribution medium
dimensions.context: Temperature described as typically sufficient for the heat distribution medium.
dimensions.ocr_raw: a temperature of 70°C is typically sufficient

fichas.title: Warm-water heat distribution and pipework layouts
fichas.summary: Warm-water central heating circulates heated water to radiators and returns cooled water to the heat generator. The page illustrates twin-pipe and single-pipe distribution arrangements, including low-level, high-level, horizontal and floor-by-floor layouts.
uses: Circulate heating water between heat generator and radiators
Distribute heat through twin-pipe or single-pipe layouts

dimensions.label: Maximum warm-water central-heating flow temperature
dimensions.context: Approximate maximum flow temperature for warm-water central heating.

dimensions.label: Preferred low-temperature flow range
dimensions.context: Range normally preferred today for warm-water central heating.

dimensions.label: Hot-water heating flow-temperature threshold
dimensions.context: Systems with flow temperatures over this threshold are classified as hot-water heating.
dimensions.ocr_raw: flow temperatures of over 120°C count as hot water heating

fichas.title: Gas, oil and solid-fuel heating
fichas.summary: Compares gas, oil and solid-fuel heating by fuel supply, storage, controllability, operating considerations and environmental impacts. Gas offers convenient supply and regulation but depends on the public utility network; oil requires storage; solid fuel requires more operator work and storage space.
uses: Provide building heat using gas, heating oil or solid fuel
